issues.detail: The skill assumes specific package managers (brew, cargo, snap) that may not be available on all platforms, limiting cross-platform compatibility.

scenarios.name: dalfox-reflected-xss-scan
scenarios.rationale: Response A fully meets all rubric items with concrete command, example findings, context, payload, and remediation; Response B lacks explicit remediation suggestions.

scenarios.name: dom-xss-detection-in-js

scenarios.name: implement-csp-and-encoding
scenarios.rationale: Both responses provide nonce‑based CSP headers and demonstrate user input encoding, but neither includes the required nh3.clean sanitization; Response A is marginally better because it uses encode_html and gives a more complete CSP example.
